representation.name: KEGG ORA DESeq2 same direction
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop('expected three RDS inputs')
names(args) <- c('97', '98', '99')

lfc_threshold <- 1.5
padj_threshold <- 0.05
organism <- 'pau'

read_result <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  df$gene_id <- rownames(df)
  if (!'log2FoldChange' %in% names(df)) stop('missing log2FoldChange column')
  df
}

res <- lapply(args, read_result)
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res, function(d) d$gene_id))

link_url <- sprintf('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/%s', organism)
pathway_url <- sprintf('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/%s', organism)
links <- read.delim(link_url, header = FALSE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c('gene', 'pathway'))
links$gene_id <- sub('^[^:]+:', '', links$gene)
links$pathway_id <- sub('^path:', '', links$pathway)
links <- unique(links[, c('gene_id', 'pathway_id')])

pnames <- read.delim(pathway_url, header = FALSE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c('pathway', 'pathway_name'))
pnames$pathway_id <- sub('^path:', '', pnames$pathway)
pnames <- pnames[, c('pathway_id', 'pathway_name')]

universe <- sort(intersect(common_genes, unique(links$gene_id)))
if (length(universe) == 0) stop('empty mapped universe')
links_u <- links[links$gene_id %in% universe, , drop = FALSE]
pathway_genes <- split(links_u$gene_id, links_u$pathway_id)
pathway_genes <- lapply(pathway_genes, unique)
pathway_ids <- names(pathway_genes)

ora_one <- function(foreground, strain, direction) {
  foreground <- sort(intersect(unique(foreground), universe))
  N <- length(universe)
  K <- length(foreground)
  rows <- lapply(pathway_ids, function(pid) {
    genes <- pathway_genes[[pid]]
    n <- length(genes)
    hits <- intersect(foreground, genes)
    q <- length(hits)
    p <- if (K == 0 || q == 0) 1 else phyper(q - 1, n, N - n, K, lower.tail = FALSE)
    data.frame(strain = strain, direction = direction, pathway_id = pid,
               universe_size = N, foreground_size = K, pathway_size = n,
               overlap = q, pvalue = p, genes = paste(hits, collapse = ','),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$padj <- p.adjust(out$pvalue, method = 'BH')
  out <- merge(out, pnames, by = 'pathway_id', all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  out[order(out$padj, out$pvalue, out$pathway_id), c('strain','direction','pathway_id','pathway_name','universe_size','foreground_size','pathway_size','overlap','pvalue','padj','genes')]
}

all_ora <- list()
for (strain in names(res)) {
  df <- res[[strain]]
  df <- df[df$gene_id %in% universe & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange), , drop = FALSE]
  all_ora[[paste(strain, 'up', sep = '_')]] <- ora_one(df$gene_id[df$log2FoldChange > lfc_threshold], strain, 'up')
  all_ora[[paste(strain, 'down', sep = '_')]] <- ora_one(df$gene_id[df$log2FoldChange < -lfc_threshold], strain, 'down')
}
ora <- do.call(rbind, all_ora)
write.table(ora, file = 'ora_results.tsv', sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

sig_sets <- list()

set -eu

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 3) stop('expected three RDS inputs')
names(args) <- c('97', '98', '99')

lfc_threshold <- 1.5
padj_threshold <- 0.05
organism <- 'pau'

read_result <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  df$gene_id <- rownames(df)
  if (!'log2FoldChange' %in% names(df)) stop('missing log2FoldChange column')
  df
}

res <- lapply(args, read_result)
common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res, function(d) d$gene_id))

link_url <- sprintf('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/%s', organism)
pathway_url <- sprintf('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/%s', organism)
links <- read.delim(link_url, header = FALSE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c('gene', 'pathway'))
links$gene_id <- sub('^[^:]+:', '', links$gene)
links$pathway_id <- sub('^path:', '', links$pathway)
links <- unique(links[, c('gene_id', 'pathway_id')])

pnames <- read.delim(pathway_url, header = FALSE, sep = '\t', stringsAsFactors = FALSE, col.names = c('pathway', 'pathway_name'))
pnames$pathway_id <- sub('^path:', '', pnames$pathway)
pnames <- pnames[, c('pathway_id', 'pathway_name')]

universe <- sort(intersect(common_genes, unique(links$gene_id)))
if (length(universe) == 0) stop('empty mapped universe')
links_u <- links[links$gene_id %in% universe, , drop = FALSE]
pathway_genes <- split(links_u$gene_id, links_u$pathway_id)
pathway_genes <- lapply(pathway_genes, unique)
pathway_ids <- names(pathway_genes)

ora_one <- function(foreground, strain, direction) {
  foreground <- sort(intersect(unique(foreground), universe))
  N <- length(universe)
  K <- length(foreground)
  rows <- lapply(pathway_ids, function(pid) {
    genes <- pathway_genes[[pid]]
    n <- length(genes)
    hits <- intersect(foreground, genes)
    q <- length(hits)
    p <- if (K == 0 || q == 0) 1 else phyper(q - 1, n, N - n, K, lower.tail = FALSE)
    data.frame(strain = strain, direction = direction, pathway_id = pid,
               universe_size = N, foreground_size = K, pathway_size = n,
               overlap = q, pvalue = p, genes = paste(hits, collapse = ','),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$padj <- p.adjust(out$pvalue, method = 'BH')
  out <- merge(out, pnames, by = 'pathway_id', all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  out[order(out$padj, out$pvalue, out$pathway_id), c('strain','direction','pathway_id','pathway_name','universe_size','foreground_size','pathway_size','overlap','pvalue','padj','genes')]
}

all_ora <- list()
for (strain in names(res)) {
  df <- res[[strain]]
  df <- df[df$gene_id %in% universe & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange), , drop = FALSE]
  all_ora[[paste(strain, 'up', sep = '_')]] <- ora_one(df$gene_id[df$log2FoldChange > lfc_threshold], strain, 'up')
  all_ora[[paste(strain, 'down', sep = '_')]] <- ora_one(df$gene_id[df$log2FoldChange < -lfc_threshold], strain, 'down')
}

write.table(ora, file = 'ora_results.tsv', sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

for (direction in c('up','down')) {
  sig_sets[[direction]] <- lapply(names(res), function(strain) {
    unique(ora$pathway_id[ora$strain == strain & ora$direction == direction & ora$padj < padj_threshold])
  })

}

common_down <- Reduce(intersect, sig_sets[['down']])
common_same <- sort(unique(c(common_up, common_down)))
summary <- data.frame(metric = c('organism','lfc_threshold','padj_threshold','universe_size','common_up_count','common_down_count','unique_same_direction_count','common_up_ids','common_down_ids'),
                      value = c(organism, lfc_threshold, padj_threshold, length(universe), length(common_up), length(common_down), length(common_same), paste(sort(common_up), collapse = ','), paste(sort(common_down), collapse = ',')),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(summary, file = 'summary.tsv', sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(length(common_same)), 'final_count.txt')

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import base64, textwrap
script = r'''
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(clusterProfiler))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) "'!= 4) stop("Expected res97 res98 res99 output paths")
paths <- args[1:3]
names(paths) <- c("97", "98", "99")
out <- args[4]
read_res <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  rn <- attr(x, "rownames")
  ld <- attr(x, "listData")
  needed <- c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(ld))
  if (length(missing) > 0) stop(paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ",")))
  data.frame(
    gene = as.character(rn),
    baseMean = as.numeric(ld[["baseMean"]]),
    log2FoldChange = as.numeric(ld[["log2FoldChange"]]),
    padj = as.numeric(ld[["padj"]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
res <- lapply(paths, read_res)
universe <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res, function(d) d$gene[!is.na(d$log2FoldChange)]))
if (length(universe) == 0) stop("Empty shared universe")
run_one <- function(genes) {
  genes <- intersect(unique(genes), universe)
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(character(0))
  ek <- enrichKEGG(
    gene = genes,
    organism = "pau",
    keyType = "kegg",
    universe = universe,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 1,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    use_internal_data = FALSE
  )
  tab <- as.data.frame(ek)
  if (nrow(tab) == 0) return(character(0))
  unique(as.character(tab$ID[!is.na(tab$p.adjust) & tab$p.adjust < 0.05]))
}
ids <- list(up = list(), down = list())
for (strain in names(res)) {
  d <- res[[strain]]
  ids$up[[strain]] <- run_one(d$gene[!is.na(d$log2FoldChange) & d$log2FoldChange > 1.5])
  ids$down[[strain]] <- run_one(d$gene[!is.na(d$log2FoldChange) & d$log2FoldChange < -1.5])
}
common_up <- Reduce(intersect, ids$up)
common_down <- Reduce(intersect, ids$down)
answer_ids <- union(common_up, common_down)
cat(length(answer_ids), "'"\\n\", sep = \"\", file = out)
message(\"universe=\", length(universe))
message(\"sig_up_counts=\", paste(names(ids"'$up), lengths(ids$up), sep=":", collapse=","))
message("sig_down_counts=", paste(names(ids$down), lengths(ids$down), sep=":", collapse=","))
message("common_up=", paste(common_up, collapse=","))
message("common_down=", paste(common_down, collapse=","))
message("answer_ids=", paste(answer_ids, collapse=","))
'"'''.strip()+\"\\n\"
print(base64.b64encode(script.encode()).decode())
PY"

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
inputs <- list(
  `97` = "$(inputs.res97.path)",
  `98` = "$(inputs.res98.path)",
  `99` = "$(inputs.res99.path)"
)
lfc_cutoff <- 1.5
write_gene_list <- function(path, genes) {
  con <- file(path, open = "wt")
  on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
  writeLines("gene_id", con)
  if (length(genes) > 0) writeLines(genes, con)
}
results <- lapply(inputs, function(path) {
  res <- readRDS(path)
  df <- as.data.frame(res)
  df$gene_id <- rownames(df)
  df
})
background <- rownames(results[[1]])
for (nm in names(results)) {
  if (!identical(background, rownames(results[[nm]]))) {
    stop(sprintf("RDS rownames differ for strain %s", nm))
  }
}
write_gene_list("background.tsv", background)
summary_rows <- data.frame(strain=character(), direction=character(), foreground_n=integer(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
for (nm in names(results)) {
  df <- results[[nm]]
  up <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange > lfc_cutoff]
  down <- df$gene_id[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange) & df$log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff]
  write_gene_list(sprintf("up%s.tsv", nm), up)
  write_gene_list(sprintf("down%s.tsv", nm), down)
  summary_rows <- rbind(summary_rows,
    data.frame(strain=nm, direction="up", foreground_n=length(up)),
    data.frame(strain=nm, direction="down", foreground_n=length(down)))
}
write.table(summary_rows, file="foreground_summary.tsv", sep="\t", quote=FALSE, row.names=FALSE)

  fg <- unique(intersect(fg, universe))
  N <- length(universe); n <- length(fg)
  sizes <- vapply(path2genes, length, integer(1))
  keep <- sizes >= minGS & sizes <= maxGS
  pt <- names(path2genes)[keep]
  out <- data.frame(pathway=pt, size=sizes[pt], hit=integer(length(pt)), pvalue=NA_real_)
  for (i in seq_along(pt)) {

read_res <- function(f) {
  x <- readRDS(f)
  ld <- attr(x, 'listData')
  data.frame(gene=attr(x,'rownames'), baseMean=ld"'$baseMean, log2FoldChange=ld$log2FoldChange,
             pvalue=ld$pvalue, padj=ld$padj, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
}
files <- c('"'97'='inputs/res_1vs97.rds','98'='inputs/res_1vs98.rds','99'='inputs/res_1vs99.rds')
res <- lapply(files, read_res)
# Fetch current KEGG membership for P. aeruginosa PA14 (pau)
link <- read.table('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', sep='\\t', stringsAsFactors=FALSE, col.names=c('gene','path'))
link"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"', '', link"'$gene)
link$path <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', link"'$path)
path_names <- read.table('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', sep='\\t', quote='', stringsAsFactors=FALSE, col.names=c('path','name'))
term2genes_all <- split(link"'$gene, link$path)
ora <- function(genes, universe, minGS=1, maxGS=Inf) {
  universe <- intersect(unique(universe), unique(link$gene))
  genes <- intersect(unique(genes), universe)
  t2g <- lapply(term2genes_all, function(g) intersect(unique(g), universe))
  sizes <- lengths(t2g)
  keep <- sizes >= minGS & sizes <= maxGS
  t2g <- t2g[keep]
  N <- length(universe); n <- length(genes)
  out <- data.frame(path=names(t2g), M=lengths(t2g), k=integer(length(t2g)), pvalue=NA_real_)
  for (i in seq_along(t2g)) {
    k <- length(intersect(genes, t2g[[i]]))
    out$k[i] <- k
    out$pvalue[i] <- if (k > 0) phyper(k-1, out$M[i], N-out$M[i], n, lower.tail=FALSE) else NA_real_
  }
  # clusterProfiler-style: only terms with hits are tested/adjusted/reported
  out <- out[!is.na(out$pvalue),]
  out$padj <- p.adjust(out$pvalue, method='"'BH')
  out"'$name <- path_names$name[match(out$path, path_names$path)]
  out[order(out$padj, out$pvalue),]
}
count_intersections <- function(alpha=0.05, fg_rule=c('"'lfc','padj05','padj10'), minGS=1, maxGS=Inf) {
  fg_rule <- match.arg(fg_rule)
  universe <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res, "'`[[`, '"'gene'))
  sigsets <- list(up=list(), down=list())
  fg_counts <- c()
  sig_counts <- c()
  for (strain in names(res)) {
    d <- res[[strain]]
    if (fg_rule == 'lfc') filt <- rep(TRUE, nrow(d))
    if (fg_rule == 'padj05') filt <- "'!is.na(d$padj) & d$padj < 0.05
    if (fg_rule == '"'padj10') filt <- "'!is.na(d$padj) & d$padj < 0.1
    for (dir in c('"'up','down')) {
      genes <- d"'$gene[filt & if (dir=='"'up') d"'$log2FoldChange > 1.5 else d$log2FoldChange < -1.5]
      er <- ora(genes, universe, minGS=minGS, maxGS=maxGS)
      sig <- er$path[er$padj < alpha]
      sigsets[[dir]][[strain]] <- sig
      fg_counts[paste(strain,dir,sep='"'_')] <- length(intersect(genes, link"'$gene))
      sig_counts[paste(strain,dir,sep='"'_')] <- length(sig)
    }
  }
  int_up <- Reduce(intersect, sigsets"'$up)
  int_down <- Reduce(intersect, sigsets$down)
  list(total=length(union(int_up, int_down)), up=sort(int_up), down=sort(int_down), fg=fg_counts, sig=sig_counts)
}
variants <- expand.grid(alpha=c(0.05,0.1), fg_rule=c('"'lfc','padj05','padj10'), minmax=c('all','cp'), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(variants))) {
  v <- variants[i,]
  mm <- if (v"'$minmax=='"'cp') c(10,500) else c(1,Inf)
  ans <- count_intersections(v"'$alpha, v$fg_rule, mm[1], mm[2])
  cat('"'\\nVAR', paste(names(v), v, sep='=', collapse=' '), 'total', ans"'$total, '"'up', length(ans"'$up), '"'down', length(ans"'$down), '"'\\n')
  cat('fg:', paste(names(ans"'$fg), ans$fg, sep='"'=', collapse=' '), '\\n')
  cat('sig:', paste(names(ans"'$sig), ans$sig, sep='"'=', collapse=' '), '\\n')
  cat('up_paths:', paste(ans"'$up, collapse='"','), '\\n')
  cat('down_paths:', paste(ans"'$down, collapse='"','), '\\n')
}

import csv, glob, os
base='/workspace/galaxy_outputs'
sets={}
for strain in ('97','98','99'):
  for direction in ('up','down'):
    path=f'{base}/{strain}_{direction}_ora.tsv'
    with open(path,newline='') as fh:
      rows=csv.DictReader(fh,delimiter='\\t')
      sets[(strain,direction)]={r['pathway_id'] for r in rows if float(r['adjusted_p_value']) < 0.05}
    print(strain,direction,len(sets[(strain,direction)]),','.join(sorted(sets[(strain,direction)])))
for direction in ('up','down'):
  common=set.intersection(*(sets[(s,direction)] for s in ('97','98','99')))
  print('COMMON',direction,len(common),','.join(sorted(common)))
up=set.intersection(*(sets[(s,'up')] for s in ('97','98','99')))
down=set.intersection(*(sets[(s,'down')] for s in ('97','98','99')))
print('UNION_UNIQUE',len(up|down),','.join(sorted(up|down)))
print('OVERLAP_BOTH',len(up&down),','.join(sorted(up&down)))
PY"

from pathlib import Path
root=Path('galaxy_outputs')
sig={}
for strain in ('97','98','99'):
  for direction in ('up','down'):
    with (root/f'{strain}_{direction}_ora.tsv').open() as f:
      rows=list(csv.DictReader(f,delimiter='\\t'))
    sig[(strain,direction)]={r['pathway_id'] for r in rows if float(r['adjusted_p_value']) < 0.05}
    print(strain,direction,len(sig[(strain,direction)]),sorted(sig[(strain,direction)]))
for d in ('up','down'):
  common=set.intersection(*(sig[(s,d)] for s in ('97','98','99')))
  print('common',d,len(common),sorted(common))
common_up=set.intersection(*(sig[(s,'up')] for s in ('97','98','99')))
common_down=set.intersection(*(sig[(s,'down')] for s in ('97','98','99')))
print('union_count',len(common_up|common_down))
print('overlap_both_directions',sorted(common_up&common_down))

import glob, warnings
from collections import defaultdict
import numpy as np
import rdata
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
# Read DE results.
res={}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('inputs/*.rds')):
    strain=f.split('vs')[-1].split('.')[0]
    x=rdata.conversion.convert(rdata.parser.parse_file(f))
    res[strain]=(set(map(str,x.rownames)),dict(zip(map(str,x.rownames),np.asarray(x.listData['log2FoldChange'],float))))
# Confirm common DE universe.
common=set.intersection(*(v[0] for v in res.values()))
union=set.union(*(v[0] for v in res.values()))
print('DE universes common/union/per-file',len(common),len(union),[len(v[0]) for v in res.values()])
# Parse KEGG PA14 mappings.
p2g=defaultdict(set)
for line in open('/tmp/kegg_pau_links.tsv'):
    gene,path=line.rstrip().split('\\t')
    p2g[path.removeprefix('path:')].add(gene.removeprefix('pau:'))
mapped=set.union(*p2g.values())
universe=common & mapped
print('KEGG pathways/unique mapped genes/shared eligible universe',len(p2g),len(mapped),len(universe),'unmapped DE',len(common-mapped))
# ClusterProfiler-like over-representation: universe-restricted sets, size 10..500,
# and BH adjustment among terms having >=1 input hit.
def bh(ps):
    ps=np.asarray(ps,float); n=len(ps); order=np.argsort(ps); out=np.empty(n); prev=1.
    for rank0 in range(n-1,-1,-1):
        idx=order[rank0]; rank=rank0+1; prev=min(prev,ps[idx]*n/rank); out[idx]=prev
    return out

def ora(fg):
    fg=set(fg)&universe
    rows=[]
    for p,genes0 in p2g.items():
        genes=genes0&universe; K=len(genes)
        if 10 <= K <= 500:
            k=len(fg&genes)
            if k:
                pv=hypergeom.sf(k-1,len(universe),K,len(fg))
                rows.append([p,k,K,pv,None])
    q=bh([r[3] for r in rows])
    for r,a in zip(rows,q):r[4]=a
    return sorted(rows,key=lambda r:r[3]), {r[0] for r in rows if r[3] <= .05 and r[4] <= .05}
all_sig={}
for strain,(rn,lfc) in res.items():
    for sign in ('up','down'):
        fg={g for g,x in lfc.items() if x>1.5} if sign=='up' else {g for g,x in lfc.items() if x< -1.5}
        rows,sig=ora(fg)
        all_sig[strain,sign]=sig
        print('\\n',strain,sign,'fg total/mapped',len(fg),len(fg&universe),'tested terms',len(rows),'sig',len(sig))
        for r in rows[:12]: print(' ',r[0],'k/K',r[1],r[2],'p',format(r[3],'.4g'),'BH',format(r[4],'.4g'),'*' if r[0] in sig else '')
up=set.intersection(*(all_sig[s,'up'] for s in res))
down=set.intersection(*(all_sig[s,'down'] for s in res))
print('\\nSAME UP',len(up),sorted(up))
print('SAME DOWN',len(down),sorted(down))
print('UNION COUNT',len(up|down),'overlap',sorted(up&down))
PY"

stopifnot(all(vapply(res[-1], function(z) setequal(rownames(z), rownames(res[[1]])), logical(1))))

link <- read.delim('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
names(link) <- c('gene','path')
link"'$gene <- sub('"'"'^pau:'"', '', link"'$gene)
link$path <- sub('"'"'^path:'"', '', link"'$path)
pnames <- read.delim('"'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
names(pnames) <- c('path','name')
ora <- function(fg, universe=universe_input, minsize=10, maxsize=500) {
  u <- intersect(unique(universe), unique(link"'$gene))
  g <- intersect(unique(fg), u)
  gs <- split(link$gene, link$path)
  gs <- lapply(gs, function(z) intersect(unique(z), u))
  sizes <- lengths(gs)
  gs <- gs[sizes >= minsize & sizes <= maxsize]
  M <- lengths(gs); k <- vapply(gs, function(z) sum(z %in% g), integer(1))
  keep <- k > 0
  M <- M[keep]; k <- k[keep]
  pv <- phyper(k-1, M, length(u)-M, length(g), lower.tail=FALSE)
  pa <- p.adjust(pv, method='"'BH')
  data.frame(path=names(M), k=k, M=M, n=length(g), N=length(u), pvalue=pv, padj=pa,
             row.names=NULL)
}
sets <- list()
for (s in names(res)) {
  d <- res[[s]]
  for (direction in c('up','down')) {
    fg <- if(direction=='up') rownames(d)[d"'$log2FoldChange > 1.5] else rownames(d)[d$log2FoldChange < -1.5]
    tab <- ora(fg)
    sig <- tab$path[tab$padj < .05]
    sets[[paste(s,direction,sep='"'_')]] <- sig
    cat(s, direction, 'foreground=',length(fg),'mapped=',unique(tab"'$n),'"'tested=',nrow(tab),'sig=',length(sig),'\\n')
    if(length(sig)) {
      z <- merge(tab[tab"'$path %in% sig,], pnames, by='"'path', all.x=TRUE)
      z <- z[order(z"'$padj),]
      print(z[,c('"'path','name','k','M','pvalue','padj')], row.names=FALSE)
    }

}

        """

        :param content: content of the new dataset to upload or a list of URLs
          (one per line) to upload

        :rtype: dict
        :return: Information about the created upload job

        See :meth:`upload_file` for the optional parameters.

import urllib.request

pattern = "$(inputs.pattern)".lower()
url = "https://rest.kegg.jp/list/organism"
request = urllib.request.Request(
    url,
    headers={"User-Agent": "Galaxy-KEGG-organism-query/1.0", "Accept": "text/plain"},
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
    text = response.read().decode("utf-8")

matches = []
for line in text.splitlines():
    if pattern in line.lower():
        matches.append(line)

if not matches:
    raise RuntimeError(f"No KEGG organism registry rows matched {pattern!r}")

with open("kegg_organism_matches.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as handle:
    handle.write("organism_registry_row\n")
    for line in matches:
        handle.write(line + "\n")

print(f"matched {len(matches)} KEGG organism rows for {pattern!r}")
PY

            out.write(f"{code}\tERROR\t{exc!r}\n")

import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

gene = "PA14_09540"
codes = ["pa14", "p14", "pau", "pse", "pae", "pao", "paz", "paf", "pab", "pao1", "pseudomonas"]
with open("kegg_pa14_code_probe.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:

    for code in codes:
        url = "https://www.kegg.jp/dbget-bin/www_bget?" + urllib.parse.quote(f"{code}:{gene}", safe=":")
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":"Galaxy-KEGG-code-probe/1.0"})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
                body = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                contains = "No such data was found." not in body
                out.write(f"{code}\t{response.status}\t{contains}\n")
        except Exception as exc:
            out.write(f"{code}\tERROR\t{exc!r}\n")
PY

def copy_history(self, history_id: str, name: str | None = None, all_datasets: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Create a new history by copying an existing one.

        :type history_id: str
        :param history_id: ID of the history to copy.

        :type name: str
        :param name: Optional name for new history

        :type all_datasets: bool
        :param all_datasets: Whether to copy also deleted datasets and dataset collections.

        :rtype: dict
        :return: Dictionary containing information about the newly created history
        """
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {"source": "history"}
        if name is not None:
            payload["name"] = name
        payload["history_id"] = history_id
        if all_datasets:
            payload["all_datasets"] = all_datasets

        return self._post(payload)

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
files = {
    '97_up': Path('galaxy_outputs/97_up_path'),
    '97_down': Path('galaxy_outputs/97_down_path'),
    '98_up': Path('galaxy_outputs/98_up_path'),
    '98_down': Path('galaxy_outputs/98_down_path'),
    '99_up': Path('galaxy_outputs/99_up_path'),
    '99_down': Path('galaxy_outputs/99_down_path'),
}
def significant(path):
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    header = lines[0].split('\\t')
    p = header.index('adjusted_p_value')
    k = header.index('pathway_id')
    return {row.split('\\t')[k] for row in lines[1:] if float(row.split('\\t')[p]) < 0.05}
sets = {k: significant(v) for k, v in files.items()}
for k in files:
    print(k, len(sets[k]))
for direction in ('up','down'):
    shared = sets[f'97_{direction}'] & sets[f'98_{direction}'] & sets[f'99_{direction}']
    print(direction, len(shared), *sorted(shared), sep='\\t')
print('total_same_direction', len((sets['97_up'] & sets['98_up'] & sets['99_up']) | (sets['97_down'] & sets['98_down'] & sets['99_down'])))
PY"

import csv
import math
import sys

def read_table(path):
    with open(path, newline="") as fh:
        reader = csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter="\t")
        required = {"rowname", "log2FoldChange"}
        missing = required.difference(reader.fieldnames or [])
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit("missing required columns in %s: %s" % (path, ",".join(sorted(missing))))
        rows = []
        for row in reader:
            gene = (row.get("rowname") or "").strip()
            value = (row.get("log2FoldChange") or "").strip()
            if not gene or gene.upper() in {"NA", "NAN"}:
                continue
            try:
                lfc = float(value)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if not math.isfinite(lfc):
                continue
            rows.append((gene, lfc))
    return rows

tables = [read_table(p) for p in sys.argv[1:]]
if len(tables) != 3:
    raise SystemExit("expected three input tables")

for label, rows in zip(("97", "98", "99"), tables):
    positive = sorted({gene for gene, lfc in rows if lfc > 1.5})
    negative = sorted({gene for gene, lfc in rows if lfc < -1.5})
    with open("pos_%s.txt" % label, "w") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(positive))
        if positive:
            fh.write("\n")
    with open("neg_%s.txt" % label, "w") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(negative))
        if negative:
            fh.write("\n")

background = set(gene for gene, _ in tables[0])
for rows in tables[1:]:
    background.intersection_update(gene for gene, _ in rows)
background = sorted(background)
with open("background.txt", "w") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(background))
    if background:
        fh.write("\n")

representation.shell_command:

import csv
import sys

def significant(path):
    result = set()
    with open(path, newline="") as fh:
        reader = csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter="\t")
        required = {"pathway_id", "adjusted_p_value"}
        missing = required.difference(reader.fieldnames or [])
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit("missing required columns in %s: %s" % (path, ",".join(sorted(missing))))
        for row in reader:
            pathway = (row.get("pathway_id") or "").strip()
            value = (row.get("adjusted_p_value") or "").strip()
            if not pathway or not value:
                continue
            try:
                adjusted = float(value)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if adjusted < 0.05:
                result.add(pathway)
    return result

pos_sets = [significant(path) for path in sys.argv[1:4]]
neg_sets = [significant(path) for path in sys.argv[4:7]]
shared_pos = set.intersection(*pos_sets)
shared_neg = set.intersection(*neg_sets)
shared_all = shared_pos | shared_neg

with open("shared_pathways.tsv", "w", newline="") as fh:
    writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["direction", "pathway_id"])
    for pathway in sorted(shared_pos):
        writer.writerow(["positive_lfc", pathway])
    for pathway in sorted(shared_neg):
        writer.writerow(["negative_lfc", pathway])

with open("shared_count.txt", "w") as fh:
    fh.write(str(len(shared_all)) + "\n")
PY

import csv
import math
import sys

def read_table(path):
    with open(path, newline="") as fh:
        reader = csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter="\t")
        required = {"rowname", "log2FoldChange"}
        missing = required.difference(reader.fieldnames or [])
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit("missing required columns in %s: %s" % (path, ",".join(sorted(missing))))
        rows = []
        for row in reader:
            gene = (row.get("rowname") or "").strip()
            value = (row.get("log2FoldChange") or "").strip()
            if not gene or gene.upper() in {"NA", "NAN"}:
                continue
            try:
                lfc = float(value)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if not math.isfinite(lfc):
                continue
            rows.append((gene, lfc))
    return rows

tables = [read_table(p) for p in sys.argv[1:]]
if len(tables) != 3:
    raise SystemExit("expected three input tables")

for label, rows in zip(("97", "98", "99"), tables):
    positive = sorted({gene for gene, lfc in rows if lfc > 1.5})
    negative = sorted({gene for gene, lfc in rows if lfc < -1.5})
    with open("pos_%s.txt" % label, "w") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(positive))
        if positive:
            fh.write("\n")
    with open("neg_%s.txt" % label, "w") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(negative))
        if negative:
            fh.write("\n")

background = set(gene for gene, _ in tables[0])
for rows in tables[1:]:
    background.intersection_update(gene for gene, _ in rows)
background = sorted(background)
with open("background.txt", "w") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(background))
    if background:
        fh.write("\n")

import csv
import sys

def significant(path):
    result = set()
    with open(path, newline="") as fh:
        reader = csv.DictReader(fh, delimiter="\t")
        required = {"pathway_id", "adjusted_p_value"}
        missing = required.difference(reader.fieldnames or [])
        if missing:
            raise SystemExit("missing required columns in %s: %s" % (path, ",".join(sorted(missing))))
        for row in reader:
            pathway = (row.get("pathway_id") or "").strip()
            value = (row.get("adjusted_p_value") or "").strip()
            if not pathway or not value:
                continue
            try:
                adjusted = float(value)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if adjusted < 0.05:
                result.add(pathway)
    return result

pos_sets = [significant(path) for path in sys.argv[1:4]]
neg_sets = [significant(path) for path in sys.argv[4:7]]
shared_pos = set.intersection(*pos_sets)
shared_neg = set.intersection(*neg_sets)
shared_all = shared_pos | shared_neg

with open("shared_pathways.tsv", "w", newline="") as fh:
    writer = csv.writer(fh, delimiter="\t", lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(["direction", "pathway_id"])
    for pathway in sorted(shared_pos):
        writer.writerow(["positive_lfc", pathway])
    for pathway in sorted(shared_neg):
        writer.writerow(["negative_lfc", pathway])

with open("shared_count.txt", "w") as fh:
    fh.write(str(len(shared_all)) + "\n")

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
files <- c(\"inputs/res_1vs97.rds\", \"inputs/res_1vs98.rds\", \"inputs/res_1vs99.rds\")
read_result <- function(f) {
  a <- attributes(readRDS(f))
  list(gene=a[[\"rownames\"]], lfc=a[[\"listData\"]][[\"log2FoldChange\"]])
}
res <- lapply(files, read_result)
links <- strsplit(readLines(\"https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau\", warn=FALSE), \"\\t\", fixed=TRUE)
map <- data.frame(
  gene=sub(\""'^pau:", "", vapply(links, `[`, "", 1)),
  path=sub("''^path:", "", vapply(links, `[`, "", 2)),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
term2gene <- lapply(split(map$gene, map$path), unique)
universe <- unique(map$gene)
ora <- function(x, direction) {
  genes <- intersect(universe, x$gene[if (direction == "up") x$lfc > 1.5 else x$lfc < -1.5])
  sets <- lapply(term2gene, intersect, y=universe)
  keep <- lengths(sets) >= 10 & lengths(sets) <= 500
  sets <- sets[keep]
  N <- length(universe); n <- length(genes); K <- lengths(sets)
  k <- vapply(sets, function(s) sum(genes %in% s), integer(1))
  p <- phyper(k - 1, K, N - K, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
  names(p)[p.adjust(p, method="BH") < 0.05]
}
sig_up <- lapply(res, ora, direction="up")
sig_down <- lapply(res, ora, direction="down")
common_up <- Reduce(intersect, sig_up)
common_down <- Reduce(intersect, sig_down)
cat("up counts:", paste(lengths(sig_up), collapse=","), "common:", length(common_up), "'"\\n\")
cat(\"down counts:\", paste(lengths(sig_down), collapse=\",\"), \"common:\", length(common_down), \"\\n\")
cat(\"answer:\", length(unique(c(common_up, common_down))), \"\\n\")
stopifnot(length(unique(c(common_up, common_down))) == 0)
RS"

/bin/bash -lc "Rscript - <<'RS'
paths <- c(\"/workspace/inputs/res_1vs97.rds\", \"/workspace/inputs/res_1vs98.rds\", \"/workspace/inputs/res_1vs99.rds\")
res <- lapply(paths, function(p) {
  x <- readRDS(p)
  ld <- attr(x, \"listData\")
  data.frame(gene=attr(x, \"rownames\"), lfc=ld"'$log2FoldChange, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
})
stopifnot(length(unique(vapply(res, nrow, integer(1)))) == 1L)
stopifnot(length(Reduce(intersect, lapply(res, `[[`, "gene"))) == nrow(res[[1]]))
links <- read.delim("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau", header=FALSE, sep="'"\\t\", quote=\"\", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
colnames(links) <- c(\"gene\", \"pathway\")
links"'$gene <- sub("''^pau:", "", links$gene)
links$pathway <- sub("''^path:", "", links$pathway)
pathgenes <- lapply(split(links$gene, links$pathway), unique)
universe <- intersect(res[[1]]$gene, unique(links$gene))
stopifnot(length(universe) == 2041L)
ora <- function(fg) {
  sets <- lapply(pathgenes, intersect, y=universe)
  gs.size <- lengths(sets)
  hits <- vapply(sets, function(s) length(intersect(s, fg)), integer(1))
  tested <- gs.size >= 10L & gs.size <= 500L & hits > 0L
  p <- rep(NA_real_, length(sets))
  p[tested] <- phyper(hits[tested] - 1L, gs.size[tested], length(universe) - gs.size[tested], length(intersect(fg, universe)), lower.tail=FALSE)
  padj <- rep(NA_real_, length(sets))
  padj[tested] <- p.adjust(p[tested], method="BH")
  names(sets)[!is.na(padj) & padj <= 0.05]
}
sig <- lapply(res, function(d) {
  list(pos=ora(d$gene[d$lfc > 1.5]), neg=ora(d$gene[d$lfc < -1.5]))
})
for (sgn in c("pos", "neg")) {
  z <- lapply(sig, `[[`, sgn)
  cat(sgn, paste(lengths(z), collapse=","), "intersection", length(Reduce(intersect, z)), "'"\\n\")
}
answer <- length(unique(c(Reduce(intersect, lapply(sig, "'`[[`, "pos")), Reduce(intersect, lapply(sig, `[[`, "neg")))))
stopifnot(answer == 0L)
cat("ANSWER", answer, "'"\\n\")
RS"

import urllib.request, csv, math, os
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

def fetch(url):
    req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        return r.read().decode()

link=fetch('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau')
# parse gene -> set paths
g2p=defaultdict(set)
for line in link.splitlines():
    if '\\t' not in line: continue
    g,p=line.split('\\t')
    g=g.split(':')[1]; p=p.split(':')[1]
    g2p[g].add(p)
p2g=defaultdict(set)
for g,ps in g2p.items():
    for p in ps: p2g[p].add(g)
db_genes=set(g2p)
all_paths=sorted(p2g)

# load csv
data={}
for f in ['tmp/res_1vs97.csv','tmp/res_1vs98.csv','tmp/res_1vs99.csv']:
    with open(f) as fh: rows=list(csv.DictReader(fh))
    data[f]={r['gene']:float(r['log2FoldChange']) for r in rows}
all_measured=set(data[list(data)[0]])
print('db genes',len(db_genes),'pathways',len(p2g),'measured overlap',len(all_measured&db_genes))

def ora(genes, universe, min_g=10, max_g=500, direction_label=''):
    genes=set(genes)&universe
    res=[]
    N=len(universe); n=len(genes)
    paths=[]
    for p in all_paths:
        K=len(p2g[p]&universe)
        if K<min_g or K>max_g: continue
        k=len(genes & p2g[p])
        if k==0: continue
        pval=hypergeom.sf(k-1,N,K,n)
        paths.append((p,k,K,pval))
    if not paths: return res
    pvals=[x[3] for x in paths]
    rej,pcorr,_,_=multipletests(pvals,method='fdr_bh')
    for (p,k,K,pval),adj in zip(paths,pcorr):
        res.append({'path':p,'k':k,'K':K,'n':n,'p':pval,'padj':adj})
    return res

# interpretation A per strain up/down
for uni_name, universe in [('db',db_genes),('measured',all_measured),('measured_and_db',all_measured&db_genes)]:

# Base R implementation matching clusterProfiler enrichKEGG defaults for organism pau
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
read_res <- function(f) {
  con <- gzfile(f, 'rb'); x <- unserialize(con); close(con)
  a <- attributes(x)
  data.frame(gene = a"'$rownames, lfc = a$listData$log2FoldChange, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
res_files <- c('"'inputs/res_1vs97.rds','inputs/res_1vs98.rds','inputs/res_1vs99.rds')
res_list <- lapply(res_files, read_res)
names(res_list) <- c('s97','s98','s99')

# download KEGG
link_url <- 'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau'
list_url <- 'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau'
link <- try(read.delim(url(link_url), header=FALSE, sep='\\t', quote=''))
listed <- try(read.delim(url(list_url), header=FALSE, sep='\\t', quote=''))
link[,1] <- sub('"'^path:'"', '', link[,1])
link[,2] <- sub('"'^pau:'"', '', link[,2])
link <- link[link[,1] %in% listed[,1], , drop=FALSE]
path2gene <- split(link[,2], link[,1])
gene2path <- split(link[,1], link[,2])
universe <- unique(link[,2])
N <- length(universe)

ora <- function(gene_ids, minGSSize=10, maxGSSize=500) {
  gene_ids <- unique(gene_ids)
  qmap <- gene2path[gene_ids]
  lens <- lengths(qmap)
  qmap <- qmap[lens > 0]
  n <- length(qmap)
  if (n == 0) return(data.frame())
  # term -> query genes
  qdf <- data.frame(gene=rep(names(qmap), lengths(qmap)), path=unlist(qmap, use.names=FALSE), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  qterm2gene <- split(qdf"'$gene, qdf$path)
  # annotate term full genes
  qterm <- names(qterm2gene)
  term2gene <- path2gene[qterm]
  term2gene <- lapply(term2gene, intersect, universe)
  sizes <- lengths(term2gene)
  keep <- sizes >= minGSSize & sizes <= maxGSSize
  term2gene <- term2gene[keep]
  qterm2gene <- qterm2gene[keep]
  if (length(term2gene)==0) return(data.frame())
  qterm <- names(qterm2gene)
  k <- lengths(qterm2gene)[qterm]
  M <- lengths(term2gene)[qterm]
  pvals <- phyper(k - 1, M, N - M, n, lower.tail = FALSE)
  padj <- p.adjust(pvals, method='"'BH')
  data.frame(ID=qterm, k=k, M=M, n=n, pvalue=pvals, p.adjust=padj, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, row.names=NULL)
}

res_all <- list()
for (i in seq_along(res_list)) {
  rr <- res_list[[i]]
  up <- rr"'$gene[rr$lfc > 1.5]
  down <- rr$gene[rr$lfc < -1.5]
  for (dir in c('"'up','down')) {
    genes <- if (dir=='up') up else down
    ora_res <- ora(genes)
    sig <- ora_res[ora_res"'$p.adjust < 0.05, '"'ID']
    key <- paste0(names(res_list)[i], '_', dir)
    res_all[[key]] <- sig
    cat(key, 'query', length(genes), 'mapped', sum(genes %in% universe), 'ORA terms tested', nrow(ora_res), 'sig', length(sig), '\\n')
    cat('  sig ids:', paste(sig, collapse=', '), '\\n')
  }
}

common_down <- Reduce(intersect, res_all[c('s97_down','s98_down','s99_down')])
cat('\\nPathway-intersection A: up', length(common_up), 'down', length(common_down), 'union', length(union(common_up, common_down)), '\\n')
cat('down ids:', paste(common_down, collapse=', '), '\\n')

# Common gene set ORA B
all_genes <- res_list[[1]]"'$gene
common_up_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res_list, function(rr) rr$gene[rr$lfc > 1.5]))
common_down_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(res_list, function(rr) rr$gene[rr$lfc < -1.5]))
cat('"'\\nCommon genes: up', length(common_up_genes), 'down', length(common_down_genes), '\\n')
for (dir in c('up','down')) {
  genes <- if (dir=='up') common_up_genes else common_down_genes
  ora_res <- ora(genes)
  sig <- ora_res[ora_res"'$p.adjust < 0.05, '"'ID']
  cat('B',dir,'sig',length(sig),paste(sig,collapse=', '),'\\n')
}
RS

# B count variations cached data
import urllib.request, csv
from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
link=urllib.request.urlopen('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau').read().decode().splitlines()
listp=set(l.split('\\t')[0] for l in urllib.request.urlopen('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau').read().decode().splitlines() if l.strip())
g2p=defaultdict(set)
for l in link:
 if '\\t' not in l:continue
 g,p=l.split('\\t'); g=g.split(':')[1]; p=p[5:]
 if p in listp:g2p[g].add(p)
p2g=defaultdict(set)
for g,ps in g2p.items():
 for p in ps:p2g[p].add(g)
db=set(g2p)
data=[]
for f in ['tmp/res_1vs97.csv','tmp/res_1vs98.csv','tmp/res_1vs99.csv']:
 with open(f) as fh:data.append({r['gene']:float(r['log2FoldChange']) for r in csv.DictReader(fh)})
common_up=set(g for g in data[0] if all(v[g]>1.5 for v in data))
common_down=set(g for g in data[0] if all(v[g]<-1.5 for v in data))
def run(mn,mx):
 for d,genes in [('up',common_up),('down',common_down)]:
  genes=genes&db; n=len(genes); rows=[]
  for p in p2g:
   K=len(p2g[p])
   if K<mn or K>mx:continue
   k=len(genes&p2g[p])
   if k==0:continue
   pv=hypergeom.sf(k-1,len(db),K,n); rows.append((p,pv))
  padj=multipletests([x[1] for x in rows],method='fdr_bh')[1] if rows else []
  sig={p for (p,pv),pa in zip(rows,padj) if pa<.05}
  print('min',mn,'max',mx,d,'genes',n,'sig',len(sig),sorted(sig))
for mn in [1,2,5,10,15]:run(mn,500)
run(10,1000)

    n=len(ps)
    if n==0:return []
    idx=sorted(range(n), key=lambda i:ps[i])
    q=[0.0]*n
    prev=1.0
    for rank,i in enumerate(idx): # rank 0-based => rank+1
        val=ps[i]*n/(rank+1)
        q[i]=min(val, prev)

        r=n-rank # n, n-1...
        raw=ps[i]*n/r
        if raw < cummin: cummin=raw
        out[i]=min(cummin,1.0)
    return out

def qvalues(ps):
    # pi0 bootstrap approximation
    m=len(ps); lam=[i/20 for i in range(1,20)]
    W=[sum(p>=l for p in ps) for l in lam]
    pi0s=[W[i]/(m*(1-lam[i])) for i in range(len(lam))]
    minpi0=sorted(pi0s)[int((len(pi0s)-1)*0.1)] if len(pi0s)>1 else min(pi0s)
    mses=[(W[i]/(m*m*(1-lam[i])**2))*(1-W[i]/m)+(pi0s[i]-minpi0)**2 for i in range(len(lam))]
    minmse=min(mses); pi0=min(min([pi0s[i] for i,v in enumerate(mses) if v==minmse]),1)
    # q values exactly R qvalue with pi0 (pfdr false)
    o=sorted(range(m), key=lambda i:-ps[i]); ro=[0]*m
    for rank,i in enumerate(o): ro[i]=rank
    cum=1.0; vals=[]
    for rank,i in enumerate(o):
        raw=ps[i]*m/(rank+1)
        cum=min(cum,raw)
        vals.append(cum)
    return [min(pi0*vals[ro[i]],1.0) for i in range(m)]

def ora(gs, full_filter=True):
    gs=set(gs)&set(g2p); mapped={g:set(g2p[g]) for g in gs}; qts=set().union(*mapped.values()) if mapped else set()
    qts={t for t in qts if 10<=len(p2g[t])<=500}; n=len(mapped); rows=[]
    for t in sorted(qts):
        k=len(p2g[t]&set(mapped));M=len(p2g[t]);den=math.comb(N,n);p=sum(math.comb(M,i)*math.comb(N-M,n-i)/den for i in range(k,min(n,M)+1));rows.append((t,k,M,n,p))
    ps=[r[4] for r in rows];pa=bh(ps);qv=qvalues(ps)
    out=[]
    for r,a,q in zip(rows,pa,qv):
        t,k,M,n,p=r
        ok=(p<=.05 and a<=.05 and (not full_filter or q<=.2))
        out.append((t,p,a,q,k,M,n,ok))
    return out

path2gene <- split(link[,1], link[,2])
gene2path <- split(link[,2], link[,1])
N <- length(unique(link[,1]))

ora <- function(genes) {
  genes <- intersect(unique(genes), names(gene2path))
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(character())
  mapped <- gene2path[genes]
  terms <- unique(unlist(mapped))
  terms <- terms[sapply(path2gene[terms], length) >= 10 & sapply(path2gene[terms], length) <= 500]
  n <- length(mapped)
  pvals <- sapply(terms, function(term) {
    k <- sum(path2gene[[term]] %in% genes)
    M <- length(path2gene[[term]])
    phyper(k - 1, M, N - M, n, lower.tail = FALSE)
  })
  padj <- p.adjust(pvals, method = 'BH')
  terms[pvals <= 0.05 & padj <= 0.05]
}

from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

files={'97':'res_1vs97.csv','98':'res_1vs98.csv','99':'res_1vs99.csv'}

def run(universe_mode='measured'):
    allkg=set(link.gene)
    sigs={}
    resgenes={}
    for strain,fn in files.items():
        df=pd.read_csv('/workspace/tmp/'+fn)
        resgenes[strain]=set(df.gene)
        up=set(df.loc[df.log2FoldChange>1.5,'gene'])
        down=set(df.loc[df.log2FoldChange< -1.5,'gene'])
        sigs[strain]={'up':up,'down':down}
    # For each strain/direction, universe depending mode
    results={}
    for strain in files:
        for direction in ['up','down']:
            if universe_mode=='measured':
                universe=resgenes[strain] & allkg
            elif universe_mode=='kegg':
                universe=allkg
            elif universe_mode=='all_measured':
                universe=resgenes[strain]
            U=len(universe)
            sel=sigs[strain][direction] & universe
            k=len(sel)
            rows=[]
            for p in link.path.unique():
                genes=set(link.loc[link.path==p,'gene']) & universe
                m=len(genes)
                q=len(genes & sel)
                # P(X>=q), R phyper(q-1, m, U-m, k, lower.tail=FALSE)
                pval=hypergeom.sf(q-1, U, m, k) if q>0 else 1.0
                rows.append((p,m,q,k,U,pval))
            d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['path','m','q','k','U','pval'])
            d=d[d.q>0].copy() if len(d)>0 else d
            if len(d)>0:

            else:
                d['padj']=[]
            d['direction']=direction
            results[(strain,direction)]=d
    return results,sigs,resgenes,allkg

for mode in ['measured','kegg','all_measured']:

    print('\\nMODE',mode)
    for strain in ['97','98','99']:
        for direction in ['up','down']:

    for direction in ['up','down']:

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import hypergeom

def bh_fdr(pvals):
    pvals=np.asarray(pvals,dtype=float); order=np.argsort(pvals); n=len(pvals)
    scaled=pvals[order]*n/np.arange(1,n+1)
    adj_sorted=np.minimum.accumulate(scaled[::-1])[::-1]
    adj=np.empty(n); adj[order]=adj_sorted
    return np.minimum(1,adj)

link=pd.read_csv('/workspace/tmp/pau_link_pathway.tsv',sep='\\t',header=None,names=['gene','path'])
link['gene']=link['gene'].str.split(':',expand=True)[1]
link['path']=link['path'].str.split(':',expand=True)[1]
pathdesc=pd.read_csv('/workspace/tmp/pau_pathways.tsv',sep='\\t',header=None,names=['path','desc'])
pathdesc['path']=pathdesc['path'].str.replace('"'^pau'"','pau',regex=True)

files={'97':'res_1vs97.csv','98':'res_1vs98.csv','99':'res_1vs99.csv'}
allkg=set(link.gene)

def run(minGSSize=10,maxGSSize=500,universe='kegg'):
    out={}
    for strain,fn in files.items():
        df=pd.read_csv('/workspace/tmp/'+fn)
        for direction,expr in [('up',df.log2FoldChange>1.5),('down',df.log2FoldChange< -1.5)]:
            gene=set(df.loc[expr,'gene'])
            # mapped selected genes to any pathway
            mapped_gene=[g for g in gene if g in allkg]
            n=len(mapped_gene)
            # term full sets
            rows=[]
            # only terms with at least one selected gene (and min/max full size)
            for p,gdf in link.groupby('path'):
                term_genes=set(gdf.gene)
                m=len(term_genes)
                if m<minGSSize or m>maxGSSize: continue
                qgenes=term_genes & gene
                q=len(qgenes)
                if q==0: continue
                pval=hypergeom.sf(q-1, len(allkg), m, n)
                rows.append((p,m,q,n,pval))
            d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['path','m','q','n','pval'])
            if len(d):
                d['padj']=bh_fdr(d.pval.values)
                d=d.sort_values('pval')
            else:
                d['padj']=pd.Series(dtype=float)
            out[(strain,direction)]=d
    return out

for minG,maxG in [(10,500),(1,1e9)]:
    out=run(minG,maxG,'kegg')
    print('\\nSIZE',minG,maxG)
    for strain in ['97','98','99']:
        for direction in ['up','down']:
            d=out[(strain,direction)]
            print(strain,direction,'tested',len(d),'mapped selected',d.n.iloc[0] if len(d) else 0,'sig padj<=.05',int((d.padj<=0.05).sum()) if len(d) else 0)
    for direction in ['up','down']:
        sets=[]
        for strain in ['97','98','99']:
            d=out[(strain,direction)]
            sets.append(set(d.loc[d.padj<=0.05,'path']))
        common=set.intersection(*sets) if sets and all(len(x)>0 for x in sets) else set()
        print('COMMON',direction,len(common),sorted(common))
    up=set(out[('97','up')].loc[out[('97','up')].padj<=0.05,'path']) & set(out[('98','up')].loc[out[('98','up')].padj<=0.05,'path']) & set(out[('99','up')].loc[out[('99','up')].padj<=0.05,'path'])
    down=set(out[('97','down')].loc[out[('97','down')].padj<=0.05,'path']) & set(out[('98','98') if False else ('98','down')].loc[out[('98','down')].padj<=0.05,'path']) & set(out[('99','down')].loc[out[('99','down')].padj<=0.05,'path'])
    print('TOTAL',len(up|down))
PY

/bin/bash -c "cat > /workspace/tmp/ora.R <<'RS'
files <- c('97'='/workspace/tmp/res_1vs97.csv','98'='/workspace/tmp/res_1vs98.csv','99'='/workspace/tmp/res_1vs99.csv')
link <- read.delim('/workspace/tmp/pau_link_pathway.tsv', header=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
link[,1] <- sub('"'^pau:'"','',link[,1])
link[,2] <- sub('"'^path:'"','',link[,2])
allkg <- unique(link[,1])
path_sizes <- table(link[,2])
paths <- names(path_sizes)
res <- list()
for (st in names(files)) {
  d <- read.csv(files[[st]], stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
  for (dir in c('up','down')) {
    if (dir=='up') gene <- d"'$gene[d$log2FoldChange > 1.5] else gene <- d$gene[d$log2FoldChange < -1.5]
    gene <- unique(gene)
    mapped <- gene[gene %in% allkg]
    n <- length(mapped)
    rows <- list()
    for (p in paths) {
      m <- as.numeric(path_sizes[[p]])
      if (m < 10 || m > 500) next
      term_genes <- link[link[,2]==p,1]
      q <- sum(gene %in% term_genes)
      if (q == 0) next
      pv <- phyper(q-1, m, length(allkg)-m, n, lower.tail=FALSE)
      rows[[p]] <- c(m=m,q=q,n=n,pv=as.numeric(pv))
    }
    if (length(rows)>0) {
      mat <- do.call(rbind, rows)
      padj <- p.adjust(mat[,'"'pv'], method='BH')
      mat <- cbind(mat, padj=padj)
      res[[paste(st,dir,sep='_')]] <- mat
      cat(st,dir,'tested',nrow(mat),'mapped',n,'sig',sum(padj<=0.05),'\\n')
    } else {
      res[[paste(st,dir,sep='_')]] <- matrix(numeric(0),ncol=4,dimnames=list(NULL,c('m','q','n','pv')))
    }
  }
}
for (dir in c('up','down')) {
  sets <- lapply(c('97','98','99'), function(st) {
    mat <- res[[paste(st,dir,sep='_')]]
    if(length(mat)>0) rownames(mat)[mat[,'padj']<=0.05] else character()
  })
  common <- Reduce(intersect, sets)
  cat('\\nCOMMON',dir,length(common),'\\n')
  print(common)
}
up <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(c('97','98','99'), function(st) {m<-res[[paste(st,'up',sep='_')]]; if(length(m)>0) rownames(m)[m[,'padj']<=0.05] else character()}))
down <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(c('97','98','99'), function(st) {m<-res[[paste(st,'down',sep='_')]]; if(length(m)>0) rownames(m)[m[,'padj']<=0.05] else character()}))
cat('TOTAL',length(union(up,down)),'\\n')
RS
Rscript /workspace/tmp/ora.R"

ORA asks: “Are my significant DE genes enriched in any pathway more than expected by chance?”

It uses a hypergeometric test (equivalent to a one-sided Fisher’s exact test):

  • Query set — significant DE genes (padj < 0.05, |LFC| >= 1), converted to gene symbols, split by direction (up- and down-regulated)
  • Background — all genes tested by DESeq2, converted to gene symbols
  • Gene sets — KEGG pathways
  • FDR correction — empirical FDR (eFDR) via resampling, which accounts for interdependence between gene sets

Key assumption: ORA treats all significant genes equally — it ignores magnitude or direction of fold change. Running ORA separately on up- and down-regulated genes partially addresses this, and is why we split the query set below. For a fully ranked approach, see Part 2 (GSEA).<

for dataset_id in seed_contents['state_ids']['ok']:

        # Get dataset info first
        ds_info = gi.datasets.show_dataset(dataset_id)

        # Copy the dataset
        gi.histories.copy_dataset(new_history_id, dataset_id, source='hda')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Error copying {dataset_id}: {e}')

# Verify
final_history = gi.histories.show_history(new_history_id, contents=True)

for ds in final_history:

print()
print('NEW_HISTORY_ID=' + new_history_id)
"

import bioblend.galaxy
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key='[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]')

# Download all three tabular outputs
tables = {
    'res_1vs97': 'f9cad7b01a472135779c06479c413dcc',
    'res_1vs98': 'f9cad7b01a472135897b85e20ffcc1e5',  
    'res_1vs99': 'f9cad7b01a47213584e7993255fbe012',
}

for name, table_id in tables.items():
    filepath = f'/workspace/{name}_tab.tsv'
    gi.datasets.download_dataset(table_id, file_path=filepath, use_default_filename=False)
    # Count lines
    with open(filepath) as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    print(f'{name}: {len(lines)} lines (incl header)')

# Also download summaries
summaries = {
    'res_1vs97_summary': 'f9cad7b01a472135f78b6da4323ff0b8',
    'res_1vs98_summary': 'f9cad7b01a472135d362a44314e035f6',
    'res_1vs99_summary': 'f9cad7b01a4721354649bdbf48a6eba6',
}

for name, summ_id in summaries.items():
    filepath = f'/workspace/{name}.txt'
    gi.datasets.download_dataset(summ_id, file_path=filepath, use_default_filename=False)
    with open(filepath) as f:
        content = f.read()
    print(f'{name}: {content[:300]}')

import urllib.request

# Get gene-to-pathway links
url = 'https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pathway/pau'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60) as resp:
    data = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
    link_lines = data.strip().split('\n')

print(f'Total gene-pathway links: {len(link_lines)}')

# Get pathway names
url2 = 'https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau'
with urllib.request.urlopen(url2, timeout=60) as resp:
    data2 = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
    path_lines = data2.strip().split('\n')

# Build pathway name lookup
path_names = {}
for line in path_lines:
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        path_id = parts[0].replace('path:', '')
        path_names[path_id] = parts[1]

print(f'Pathway names: {len(path_names)}')

# Create mapping table: gene_id, pathway_id, pathway_name
with open('/workspace/pau_kegg_mapping.tsv', 'w') as f:
    f.write('gene_id\tpathway_id\tpathway_name\n')
    for line in link_lines:
        parts = line.split('\t')
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            gene_full = parts[0]  # pau:PA14_XXXXX
            path_full = parts[1]  # path:pauXXXXX
            
            gene_id = gene_full.replace('pau:', '')
            path_id = path_full.replace('path:', '')
            path_name = path_names.get(path_id, path_id)
            
            f.write(f'{gene_id}\t{path_id}\t{path_name}\n')

# Count unique genes and pathways in mapping
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['wc', '-l', '/workspace/pau_kegg_mapping.tsv'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(f'Mapping lines: {result.stdout.strip()}')

# Count unique
genes = set()
pathways = set()
with open('/workspace/pau_kegg_mapping.tsv') as f:
    next(f)  # header
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            genes.add(parts[0])
            pathways.add(parts[1])
print(f'Unique genes: {len(genes)}')
print(f'Unique pathways: {len(pathways)}')
print(f'Sample: {list(genes)[:5]}')
" 2>&1

for strain in ['97', '98', '99']:
    fpath = f'/workspace/res_1vs{strain}_tab.tsv'
    genes = {}
    with open(fpath) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
        for row in reader:
            gene = row['rowname']
            lfc = float(row['log2FoldChange'])
            padj = float(row['padj'])
            genes[gene] = {'lfc': lfc, 'padj': padj}
    gene_data[strain] = genes

# Find genes with |lfc| > 1.5 and same direction across all 3
all_genes = set(gene_data['97'].keys()) & set(gene_data['98'].keys()) & set(gene_data['99'].keys())
print(f'Genes in all 3: {len(all_genes)}')

# Up in all 3
up_all = set()
down_all = set()
for gene in all_genes:
    lfcs = [gene_data[s][gene]['lfc'] for s in ['97', '98', '99']]
    if all(l > 1.5 for l in lfcs):
        up_all.add(gene)
    if all(l < -1.5 for l in lfcs):
        down_all.add(gene)

print(f'Genes with lfc > 1.5 in ALL 3 strains: {len(up_all)}')
for g in sorted(up_all):
    print(f'  {g}: lfc97={gene_data[\"97\"][g][\"lfc\"]:.2f}, lfc98={gene_data[\"98\"][g][\"lfc\"]:.2f}, lfc99={gene_data[\"99\"][g][\"lfc\"]:.2f}')

print(f'Genes with lfc < -1.5 in ALL 3 strains: {len(down_all)}')
for g in sorted(down_all)[:20]:
    print(f'  {g}: lfc97={gene_data[\"97\"][g][\"lfc\"]:.2f}, lfc98={gene_data[\"98\"][g][\"lfc\"]:.2f}, lfc99={gene_data[\"99\"][g][\"lfc\"]:.2f}')
if len(down_all) > 20:
    print(f'  ... and {len(down_all)-20} more')

# Also check: genes with |lfc| > 1.5 in at least one strain and consistent sign across all 3
same_sign_all = set()
for gene in all_genes:
    lfcs = [gene_data[s][gene]['lfc'] for s in ['97', '98', '99']]
    signs = [1 if l > 0 else -1 for l in lfcs]
    if len(set(signs)) == 1:  # all same sign
        if any(abs(l) > 1.5 for l in lfcs):  # at least one |lfc| > 1.5
            same_sign_all.add(gene)
print(f'Genes with consistent sign AND at least one |lfc|>1.5: {len(same_sign_all)}')

# Create gene lists for the strictly consistent ones

for direction, geneset in [('up', up_all), ('down', down_all)]:
    fpath = f'/workspace/genes_consistent_{direction}.txt'
    with open(fpath, 'w') as f:
        for g in sorted(geneset):
            f.write(g + '\n')
    print(f'Wrote {fpath}: {len(geneset)} genes')

# Final cross-check: compute overlap of enriched pathways across all three strains
# Interpretation: per-strain ORA (split by direction), padj < 0.05, overlap

import csv

# Get significant pathways for each strain + direction
sig = {}
for strain in ['97', '98', '99']:
    for direction in ['up', 'down']:
        key = f'{strain}_{direction}'
        fpath = f'/workspace/kegg_ora_{key}.tsv'
        sig[key] = set()
        with open(fpath) as f:
            reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
            for row in reader:
                if float(row['adjusted_p_value']) < 0.05:
                    sig[key].add(row['pathway_id'])

print('Significant pathways per strain+direction:')
for key, pathways in sig.items():
    print(f'  {key}: {len(pathways)} - {sorted(pathways)}')

# Overlap in up direction
up_overlap = sig['97_up'] & sig['98_up'] & sig['99_up']
print(f'\\nUp overlap (all 3): {len(up_overlap)}')

# Overlap in down direction
down_overlap = sig['97_down'] & sig['98_down'] & sig['99_down']
print(f'Down overlap (all 3): {len(down_overlap)}')

# Total pathways enriched in same direction for all 3
total = len(up_overlap) + len(down_overlap)
print(f'\\nTotal pathways significantly enriched in same direction for all 3 strains: {total}')

from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

API_KEY = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
SEED_HISTORY_ID = "bbd44e69cb8906b5890f56fa4d9915ae"
GALAXY_URL = "https://usegalaxy.org"

gi = GalaxyInstance(GALAXY_URL, API_KEY)

# Get seed history to find its name
seed_info = gi.histories.show_history(SEED_HISTORY_ID)
print(f"Seed history: {seed_info['name']}")

# Copy the history
# The history API doesn't have a direct "copy" method, but we can create a new history
# and copy datasets into it
new_history = gi.histories.create_history(name=f"Copy of {seed_info['name']}")
new_history_id = new_history['id']
print(f"New history ID: {new_history_id}")

# Copy all datasets from seed to new history
contents = gi.histories.show_history(SEED_HISTORY_ID, contents=True)
for item in contents:
    if item['type'] == 'dataset':
        dataset_id = item['id']
        name = item.get('name', 'unknown')
        print(f"Copying dataset: {name} (ID: {dataset_id})")
        gi.histories.copy_dataset(new_history_id, dataset_id, source='hda')

print(f"\nNew history created: {new_history_id}")
print("Done copying.")

# Verify
new_contents = gi.histories.show_history(new_history_id, contents=True)
print(f"\nNew history contents ({len(new_contents)} items):")
for item in new_contents:
    print(f"  {item.get('name')} - {item.get('state')} - {item.get('id')}")
EOF

import csv

def get_significant_pathways(filepath, padj_threshold=0.05):
    """Extract pathway IDs with adjusted p-value < threshold"""
    pathways = set()
    with open(filepath) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
        for row in reader:
            try:
                padj = float(row['adjusted_p_value'])
                if padj < padj_threshold:
                    pathways.add(row['pathway_id'])
            except (ValueError, KeyError):
                continue
    return pathways

# Get significant pathways for each analysis
up_97 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_up_97.tsv")
up_98 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_up_98.tsv")
up_99 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_up_99.tsv")
down_97 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_down_97.tsv")
down_98 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_down_98.tsv")
down_99 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_down_99.tsv")

print("=== Upregulated significant pathways ===")
print(f"up_97: {len(up_97)} pathways: {sorted(up_97)}")
print(f"up_98: {len(up_98)} pathways: {sorted(up_98)}")
print(f"up_99: {len(up_99)} pathways: {sorted(up_99)}")

print("\n=== Downregulated significant pathways ===")
print(f"down_97: {len(down_97)} pathways: {sorted(down_97)}")
print(f"down_98: {len(down_98)} pathways: {sorted(down_98)}")
print(f"down_99: {len(down_99)} pathways: {sorted(down_99)}")

# Intersections
up_intersection = up_97 & up_98 & up_99
down_intersection = down_97 & down_98 & down_99

print("\n=== Upregulated Intersection (all 3 strains) ===")
print(f"Pathways: {sorted(up_intersection)}")
print(f"Count: {len(up_intersection)}")

print("\n=== Downregulated Intersection (all 3 strains) ===")
print(f"Pathways: {sorted(down_intersection)}")
print(f"Count: {len(down_intersection)}")

total = len(up_intersection) + len(down_intersection)
print(f"\n=== Total pathways enriched in same direction across all 3 strains: {total} ===")

# Also show pathway names for the intersecting ones
def get_pathway_names(filepath, pathway_ids):
    names = {}
    with open(filepath) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
        for row in reader:
            pid = row['pathway_id']
            if pid in pathway_ids and pid not in names:
                names[pid] = row['pathway_name']
    return names

if up_intersection:
    print("\nUpregulated intersecting pathway details:")
    names = get_pathway_names("/workspace/kegg_ora_up_97.tsv", up_intersection)
    for pid in sorted(up_intersection):
        print(f"  {pid}: {names.get(pid, 'unknown')}")

if down_intersection:
    print("\nDownregulated intersecting pathway details:")
    names = get_pathway_names("/workspace/kegg_ora_down_97.tsv", down_intersection)
    for pid in sorted(down_intersection):
        print(f"  {pid}: {names.get(pid, 'unknown')}")
EOF

import csv

def get_significant_pathways(filepath, padj_threshold=0.05):
    pathways = {}
    with open(filepath) as f:
        reader = csv.DictReader(f, delimiter='\t')
        for row in reader:
            try:
                padj = float(row['adjusted_p_value'])
                pid = row['pathway_id']
                if padj < padj_threshold:
                    pathways[pid] = {
                        'name': row['pathway_name'],
                        'padj': padj,
                        'hits': row['foreground_hits'],
                        'pathway_size': row['pathway_genes_in_universe'],
                    }
            except (ValueError, KeyError):
                continue
    return pathways

# Get significant pathways
up_97 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_fh_up_97.tsv")
up_98 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_fh_up_98.tsv")
up_99 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_fh_up_99.tsv")
down_97 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_fh_down_97.tsv")
down_98 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_fh_down_98.tsv")
down_99 = get_significant_pathways("/workspace/kegg_ora_fh_down_99.tsv")

    print(f"\n{label}: {len(data)} pathways")
    for pid, info in sorted(data.items()):
        print(f"  {pid}: {info['name']} (padj={info['padj']:.2e})")

print("\n=== DOWNREGULATED significant pathways (padj < 0.05) ===")
for label, data in [("down_97", down_97), ("down_98", down_98), ("down_99", down_99)]:

down_intersection = set(down_97.keys()) & set(down_98.keys()) & set(down_99.keys())

print("\n=== UP Intersection (all 3 strains):", sorted(up_intersection), f"= {len(up_intersection)}")
print("=== DOWN Intersection (all 3 strains):", sorted(down_intersection), f"= {len(down_intersection)}")
print(f"\n=== TOTAL: {len(up_intersection) + len(down_intersection)}")

api_key = open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b587ee340204072eed'
headers = {'x-api-key': api_key}

table_ids = {
    '97': 'f9cad7b01a4721350017ab9ce9731044',
    '98': 'f9cad7b01a472135e81f8bfec6b4abf2',
    '99': 'f9cad7b01a4721358e099cf6a46cc01d'
}

for strain, ds_id in table_ids.items():
    r = requests.get(f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{hist_id}/contents/{ds_id}/display', headers=headers)
    
    genes_up = []
    genes_down = []
    all_genes = []
    lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0]
    print(f"\n=== Strain {strain}: {len(lines)-1} data rows ===")
    
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        fields = line.split('\t')
        gene = fields[0]
        all_genes.append(gene)
        try:
            lfc = float(fields[2])  # log2FoldChange is column 3 (0-indexed: 2)
            if lfc > 1.5:
                genes_up.append(gene)
            elif lfc < -1.5:
                genes_down.append(gene)
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            pass
    
    print(f"  All genes: {len(all_genes)}")
    print(f"  Up-regulated (LFC > 1.5): {len(genes_up)}")
    print(f"  Down-regulated (LFC < -1.5): {len(genes_down)}")
    
    # Write gene lists
    os.makedirs('/tmp/gene_lists', exist_ok=True)
    with open(f'/tmp/gene_lists/strain{strain}_up.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write('gene\n')
        for g in genes_up:
            f.write(f'{g}\n')
    with open(f'/tmp/gene_lists/strain{strain}_down.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write('gene\n')
        for g in genes_down:
            f.write(f'{g}\n')
    # Also write all genes for background
    with open(f'/tmp/gene_lists/strain{strain}_all.txt', 'w') as f:
        f.write('gene\n')
        for g in all_genes:
            f.write(f'{g}\n')

# Show some example gene names
print("\n=== Sample gene IDs ===")
with open('/tmp/gene_lists/strain97_down.txt') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()[:6]
    for l in lines:
        print(f"  {l.strip()}")

import requests, os

api_key = open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
hist_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b587ee340204072eed'
headers = {'x-api-key': api_key}

# Check if KEGG ORA output has any fold enrichment / odds ratio
# Also check contributing_genes outputs
contrib = {
    '97_up': 'f9cad7b01a472135519e8d4bcf43c10f',
    '97_down': 'f9cad7b01a472135d2965dc18a16f95b',
}

print("=== Contributing genes output (sample) ===")
for key, ds_id in contrib.items():
    r = requests.get(f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{hist_id}/contents/{ds_id}/display', headers=headers)
    lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
    print(f"\n--- {key} ---")
    print(f"Header: {lines[0]}")
    for line in lines[1:4]:
        print(f"  {line[:200]}")

# Re-examine: what about using padj threshold differently?
# Let me check if any pathway approaches significance across all three
print("\n\n=== Checking all pathways, not just padj < 0.05 ===")

results = {
    '97_up': 'f9cad7b01a472135d84452f965ad02dc',
    '97_down': 'f9cad7b01a4721357b71c72819d783d9',
    '98_up': 'f9cad7b01a4721357e9c33a7eb886623',
    '98_down': 'f9cad7b01a472135dd6bb1bbe520c639',
    '99_up': 'f9cad7b01a472135f822e5ec6eb08e66',
    '99_down': 'f9cad7b01a472135c2466fc5c4245da9',
}

# Get ALL pathways for each condition (not just significant)
all_pathways = {}
for key, ds_id in results.items():
    r = requests.get(f'https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/{hist_id}/contents/{ds_id}/display', headers=headers)
    lines = r.text.strip().split('\n')
    header = lines[0].split('\t')
    all_pathways[key] = {}
    for line in lines[1:]:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        fields = line.split('\t')
        row = dict(zip(header, fields))
        all_pathways[key][row['pathway_id']] = {
            'name': row['pathway_name'],
            'padj': float(row['adjusted_p_value']),
            'pval': float(row['p_value']),
            'hits': row['foreground_hits'],
            'pw_genes': row['pathway_genes_in_universe']
        }

# Check DOWN direction with looser thresholds
print("\nDOWN direction - pathways present in all 3 (any padj):")
down_97 = set(all_pathways['97_down'].keys())
down_98 = set(all_pathways['98_down'].keys())
down_99 = set(all_pathways['99_down'].keys())
down_all = down_97 & down_98 & down_99
print(f"  97_down: {len(down_97)} pathways")
print(f"  98_down: {len(down_98)} pathways")
print(f"  99_down: {len(down_99)} pathways")
print(f"  Intersection: {len(down_all)} pathways")

for pid in sorted(down_all):
    p97 = all_pathways['97_down'][pid]
    p98 = all_pathways['98_down'][pid]
    p99 = all_pathways['99_down'][pid]
    print(f"  {pid}: padj 97={p97['padj']:.2e}, 98={p98['padj']:.2e}, 99={p99['padj']:.2e}")

print("\nUP direction - pathways present in all 3 (any padj):")
up_97 = set(all_pathways['97_up'].keys())
up_98 = set(all_pathways['98_up'].keys())
up_99 = set(all_pathways['99_up'].keys())
up_all = up_97 & up_98 & up_99
print(f"  97_up: {len(up_97)} pathways")
print(f"  98_up: {len(up_98)} pathways")
print(f"  99_up: {len(up_99)} pathways")
print(f"  Intersection: {len(up_all)} pathways")

for pid in sorted(up_all):
    p97 = all_pathways['97_up'][pid]
    p98 = all_pathways['98_up'][pid]
    p99 = all_pathways['99_up'][pid]
    print(f"  {pid}: padj 97={p97['padj']:.2e}, 98={p98['padj']:.2e}, 99={p99['padj']:.2e}")

# Extract data from all three RDS files
extract_df <- function(path) {
  x <- readRDS(path)
  ld <- attr(x, "listData")
  rn <- attr(x, "rownames")
  df <- data.frame(
    gene = rn,
    baseMean = ld$baseMean,
    log2FoldChange = ld$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE = ld$lfcSE,
    stat = ld$stat,
    pvalue = ld$pvalue,
    padj = ld$padj,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  return(df)
}

res97 <- extract_df("/workspace/inputs/res_1vs97.rds")
res98 <- extract_df("/workspace/inputs/res_1vs98.rds")
res99 <- extract_df("/workspace/inputs/res_1vs99.rds")

cat("res97 dimensions:", dim(res97), "\n")
cat("res98 dimensions:", dim(res98), "\n")
cat("res99 dimensions:", dim(res99), "\n")

# Find genes with |lfc| > 1.5 in each
up97 <- res97$gene[res97$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
down97 <- res97$gene[res97$log2FoldChange < -1.5]
up98 <- res98$gene[res98$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
down98 <- res98$gene[res98$log2FoldChange < -1.5]
up99 <- res99$gene[res99$log2FoldChange > 1.5]
down99 <- res99$gene[res99$log2FoldChange < -1.5]

cat("\n|LFC|>1.5 genes in each strain:\n")
cat("97: up=", length(up97), " down=", length(down97), "\n")
cat("98: up=", length(up98), " down=", length(down98), "\n")
cat("99: up=", length(up99), " down=", length(down99), "\n")

# Find genes consistently up (lfc > 1.5) in all three
consistently_up <- intersect(intersect(up97, up98), up99)
cat("\nConsistently upregulated (lfc > 1.5) in all 3:", length(consistently_up), "\n")

# Find genes consistently down (lfc < -1.5) in all three
consistently_down <- intersect(intersect(down97, down98), down99)
cat("Consistently downregulated (lfc < -1.5) in all 3:", length(consistently_down), "\n")

# Combined set for ORA
all_consistent <- union(consistently_up, consistently_down)
cat("Total consistently DE in same direction:", length(all_consistent), "\n")

# Save for later use
writeLines(consistently_up, "/workspace/consistent_up_genes.txt")
writeLines(consistently_down, "/workspace/consistent_down_genes.txt")
writeLines(all_consistent, "/workspace/consistent_genes.txt")

# Save full data
saveRDS(res97, "/workspace/res97_df.rds")
saveRDS(res98, "/workspace/res98_df.rds")
saveRDS(res99, "/workspace/res99_df.rds")

# Show some examples
cat("\nFirst 20 consistently upregulated:\n")
print(head(consistently_up, 20))
cat("\nFirst 20 consistently downregulated:\n")
print(head(consistently_down, 20))

events.stdout_excerpt:
Based on the KEGG API Manual:

**Base URL:** `https://rest.kegg.jp/`

**General URL form:** `"https://rest.kegg.jp/<operation>/<argument>[/<argument2[/<argument3 ...]]]"` where the operation can be info, list, find, get, conv, link, or ddi.

**Listing organisms:** The manual notes that the "special database name 'organism' is allowed only in this operation," referring to the `list` operation, and it "may be used to obtain a list of KEGG organisms with the three- or four-letter organism codes." The correct format is therefore:

```
https://rest.kegg.jp/list/organism
```
