"""
KEGG ORA for three P. aeruginosa mutant strains (97, 98, 99) vs wildtype.
Find pathways significantly enriched (|lfc| > 1.5) in the same direction
across all three strains.
"""
import rdata
import numpy as np
import requests
import warnings
from scipy.stats import hypergeom
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# ── 1. Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("Loading RDS files...")
res97 = rdata.read_rda('/workspace/inputs/res_1vs97.rds')
res98 = rdata.read_rda('/workspace/inputs/res_1vs98.rds')
res99 = rdata.read_rda('/workspace/inputs/res_1vs99.rds')

genes = [str(g) for g in res97.rownames]
n_genes = len(genes)
print(f"Total genes: {n_genes}")

# Extract results for each comparison
def get_results(res):
    return {
        'genes': [str(g) for g in res.rownames],
        'lfc': res.listData['log2FoldChange'],
        'pvalue': res.listData['pvalue'],
        'padj': res.listData['padj'],
    }

data97 = get_results(res97)
data98 = get_results(res98)
data99 = get_results(res99)

# ── 2. Get KEGG pathway-gene mappings for pau (P. aeruginosa PA14) ────
print("Fetching KEGG pathway data...")
r_link = requests.get('https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pau/pathway', timeout=30)
links = r_link.text.strip().split('\n')

# Build pathway -> gene set mapping
pathway_genes = {}
for line in links:
    parts = line.strip().split('\t')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        pathway_id = parts[0].replace('path:', '')  # e.g., pau00010
        gene = parts[1].replace('pau:', '')         # e.g., PA14_07190
        if pathway_id not in pathway_genes:
            pathway_genes[pathway_id] = set()
        pathway_genes[pathway_id].add(gene)

print(f"Pathways with genes: {len(pathway_genes)}")

# Get pathway names
r_list = requests.get('https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau', timeout=30)
pathway_names = {}
for line in r_list.text.strip().split('\n'):
    parts = line.split('\t')
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        pid = parts[0].replace('path:', '')
        pathway_names[pid] = parts[1]

# ── 3. Define universe and foregrounds ────────────────────────────────
all_genes_set = set(genes)

# Universe: all tested genes that map to at least one KEGG pathway
kegg_mapped_genes = set()
for gset in pathway_genes.values():
    kegg_mapped_genes |= gset
universe = kegg_mapped_genes & all_genes_set
print(f"Universe (mapped genes): {len(universe)}")

# Filter pathway gene sets to universe
for pid in pathway_genes:
    pathway_genes[pid] = pathway_genes[pid] & universe

# Remove pathways with fewer than 5 genes in universe (standard filter)
pathway_genes = {pid: gs for pid, gs in pathway_genes.items() if len(gs) >= 5}
print(f"Pathways with >=5 genes in universe: {len(pathway_genes)}")

# Define foreground for each comparison: |lfc| > 1.5
def get_foreground(data, direction='up'):
    genes_arr = np.array(data['genes'])
    lfc = data['lfc']
    if direction == 'up':
        mask = lfc > 1.5
    else:  # down
        mask = lfc < -1.5
    fg = set(genes_arr[mask]) & universe
    return fg

# ── 4. Run ORA for each comparison and direction ──────────────────────
def run_ora(foreground, universe, pathway_genes):
    """Run hypergeometric test for each pathway."""
    N = len(universe)  # total genes in universe
    K = len(foreground)  # total DE genes
    results = []

    for pid, pathway_set in pathway_genes.items():
        n = len(pathway_set)  # genes in pathway
        k = len(foreground & pathway_set)  # DE genes in pathway

        if k == 0:
            continue

        # hypergeom.sf(k-1, N, n, K) = P(X >= k)
        pval = hypergeom.sf(k - 1, N, n, K)

        results.append({
            'pathway_id': pid,
            'pathway_name': pathway_names.get(pid, ''),
            'n_pathway': n,
            'k_overlap': k,
            'fg_size': K,
            'pvalue': pval,
        })

    return results

all_ora_results = {}
for label, data in [('97', data97), ('98', data98), ('99', data99)]:
    for direction in ['up', 'down']:
        fg = get_foreground(data, direction)
        print(f"Strain {label} {direction}: foreground = {len(fg)} genes")
        raw = run_ora(fg, universe, pathway_genes)

        # Apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction
        if len(raw) > 0:
            pvals = [r['pvalue'] for r in raw]
            _, padjs, _, _ = multipletests(pvals, method='fdr_bh')
            for i, r in enumerate(raw):
                r['padj'] = padjs[i]
        else:
            for r in raw:
                r['padj'] = 1.0

        all_ora_results[(label, direction)] = raw

# ── 5. Find pathways enriched in the same direction across all three ──
print("\n=== Finding consistently enriched pathways (FDR < 0.05) ===")

def get_significant_pathways(ora_results, padj_cutoff=0.05):
    """Return set of pathway IDs with padj < cutoff."""
    return {r['pathway_id'] for r in ora_results if r['padj'] < padj_cutoff}

sig_up_97 = get_significant_pathways(all_ora_results[('97', 'up')])
sig_up_98 = get_significant_pathways(all_ora_results[('98', 'up')])
sig_up_99 = get_significant_pathways(all_ora_results[('99', 'up')])
sig_down_97 = get_significant_pathways(all_ora_results[('97', 'down')])
sig_down_98 = get_significant_pathways(all_ora_results[('98', 'down')])
sig_down_99 = get_significant_pathways(all_ora_results[('99', 'down')])

print(f"Significant up 97: {len(sig_up_97)}")
print(f"Significant up 98: {len(sig_up_98)}")
print(f"Significant up 99: {len(sig_up_99)}")
print(f"Significant down 97: {len(sig_down_97)}")
print(f"Significant down 98: {len(sig_down_98)}")
print(f"Significant down 99: {len(sig_down_99)}")

# Intersect: same direction across all three
up_all3 = sig_up_97 & sig_up_98 & sig_up_99
down_all3 = sig_down_97 & sig_down_98 & sig_down_99

print(f"\nUp-regulated in all 3: {len(up_all3)}")
for pid in sorted(up_all3):
    name = pathway_names.get(pid, pid)
    print(f"  {pid}: {name}")

print(f"\nDown-regulated in all 3: {len(down_all3)}")
for pid in sorted(down_all3):
    name = pathway_names.get(pid, pid)
    print(f"  {pid}: {name}")

total = len(up_all3) + len(down_all3)
print(f"\n=== TOTAL: {total} pathways ===")

# Write answer
with open('/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(total) + '\n')
print("Answer written to codex_output/answer.txt")

process_rds <- function(fname, outname) {
  x <- readRDS(fname)
  a <- attributes(x)
  ld <- a$listData
  df <- data.frame(
    gene = a$rownames,
    baseMean = ld$baseMean,
    log2FoldChange = ld$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE = ld$lfcSE,

    pvalue = ld$pvalue,

}

import requests, json, csv, time
from collections import defaultdict

# Step 1: Get KEGG pathways for pau
print("=== Getting pathways for pau ===")
r = requests.get("https://rest.kegg.jp/list/pathway/pau", timeout=30)
pathways = {}
for line in r.text.strip().split("\n"):
    parts = line.split("\t")
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        pid, desc = parts[0], parts[1]
        pid_short = pid.replace("path:", "")
        pathways[pid_short] = desc

print(f"Total pathways: {len(pathways)}")
for pid, desc in list(pathways.items())[:10]:
    print(f"  {pid}: {desc[:80]}")
print("  ...")

# Step 2: Get pathway-gene links
print("\n=== Getting pathway-gene links ===")
time.sleep(0.5)
r = requests.get("https://rest.kegg.jp/link/pau/pathway", timeout=60)
pathway_genes = defaultdict(set)
for line in r.text.strip().split("\n"):
    parts = line.split("\t")
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        pid = parts[0].replace("path:", "")
        gene = parts[1].replace("pau:", "")
        pathway_genes[pid].add(gene)

print(f"Pathways with genes: {len(pathway_genes)}")
for pid, genes in list(pathway_genes.items())[:5]:
    print(f"  {pid}: {len(genes)} genes")

# Save to file for later use
import pickle
with open("/tmp/analysis/kegg_data.pkl", "wb") as f:
    pickle.dump({"pathways": pathways, "pathway_genes": dict(pathway_genes)}, f)

# Step 3: Show some gene IDs from pathway-gene links to understand format
all_genes_in_pathways = set()
for genes in pathway_genes.values():
    all_genes_in_pathways.update(genes)
print(f"\nTotal unique genes in pathways: {len(all_genes_in_pathways)}")
print(f"Example gene IDs: {list(all_genes_in_pathways)[:10]}")
PYEOF

res_98 = pd.read_csv("/tmp/analysis/res_98.csv")
res_99 = pd.read_csv("/tmp/analysis/res_99.csv")

    kegg_data = pickle.load(f)

pathway_genes_raw = {k: set(v) for k, v in kegg_data["pathway_genes"].items()}
pathways = kegg_data["pathways"]

def run_kegg_ora(res_df, pathway_genes, lfc_threshold=1.5, pval_threshold=0.05):
    """
    Run KEGG ORA for a single strain comparison.
    
    Returns dict with pathway -> {direction, pvalue, odds_ratio, gene_count, ...}
    """
    # Define universe: all genes in our data that have KEGG annotations
    all_genes = set(res_df["gene"])
    all_pathway_genes = set()
    for genes in pathway_genes.values():
        all_pathway_genes.update(genes)
    universe = all_genes & all_pathway_genes
    
    # Define DE genes: |lfc| > threshold and padj < threshold
    de_up = set(res_df[(res_df["log2FoldChange"] > lfc_threshold) & 
                         (res_df["padj"] < pval_threshold)]["gene"])
    de_down = set(res_df[(res_df["log2FoldChange"] < -lfc_threshold) & 
                           (res_df["padj"] < pval_threshold)]["gene"])
    
    # Intersect with universe
    de_up = de_up & universe
    de_down = de_down & universe
    
    n_universe = len(universe)
    n_de_up = len(de_up)
    n_de_down = len(de_down)
    
    print(f"  Universe: {n_universe}, DE up: {n_de_up}, DE down: {n_de_down}")
    
    results = {}
    
    # ORA for each pathway and direction
    for pid, pw_genes in pathway_genes.items():
        pw_genes_in_universe = pw_genes & universe
        
        if len(pw_genes_in_universe) < 2:  # skip very small pathways
            continue
        
        # Up-regulated
        overlap_up = pw_genes_in_universe & de_up
        a = len(overlap_up)
        b = n_de_up - a
        c = len(pw_genes_in_universe) - a
        d = n_universe - n_de_up - c
        
        if a > 0:
            table = [[a, b], [c, d]]
            odds_ratio, pval = fisher_exact(table, alternative='greater')
            results[(pid, 'up')] = {
                'pvalue': pval,
                'odds_ratio': odds_ratio,
                'overlap': a,
                'pathway_size': len(pw_genes_in_universe),
                'de_size': n_de_up,
                'genes': overlap_up
            }
        
        # Down-regulated
        overlap_down = pw_genes_in_universe & de_down
        a = len(overlap_down)
        b = n_de_down - a
        c = len(pw_genes_in_universe) - a
        d = n_universe - n_de_down - c
        
        if a > 0:
            table = [[a, b], [c, d]]
            odds_ratio, pval = fisher_exact(table, alternative='greater')
            results[(pid, 'down')] = {
                'pvalue': pval,
                'odds_ratio': odds_ratio,
                'overlap': a,
                'pathway_size': len(pw_genes_in_universe),
                'de_size': n_de_down,
                'genes': overlap_down
            }
    
    # Adjust p-values across all tests (both directions)
    if len(results) > 0:
        pvals = [r['pvalue'] for r in results.values()]
        keys = list(results.keys())
        _, padjs, _, _ = multipletests(pvals, method='fdr_bh')
        for key, padj in zip(keys, padjs):
            results[key]['padj'] = padj
    
    return results, universe, de_up, de_down

consist_down = sig_paths['97']['down'] & sig_paths['98']['down'] & sig_paths['99']['down']

print(f"\nConsistently enriched UP across all 3 strains: {len(consist_up)}")

for pid in sorted(consist_down):
    print(f"  {pid}: {pathways.get(pid, 'N/A')[:80]}")

print(f"\nTotal consistently enriched (same direction): {len(consist_up) + len(consist_down)}")

# Save for later
with open("/tmp/analysis/ora_results.pkl", "wb") as f:
    pickle.dump({
        'ora_97': ora_97, 'ora_98': ora_98, 'ora_99': ora_99,
        'consist_up': consist_up, 'consist_down': consist_down,
        'sig_paths': sig_paths
    }, f)

from collections import defaultdict
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

    kegg_data = pickle.load(f)

de_down_97 = set(res_97[res_97["log2FoldChange"] < -1.5]["gene"])

de_down_98 = set(res_98[res_98["log2FoldChange"] < -1.5]["gene"])
de_up_99 = set(res_99[res_99["log2FoldChange"] > 1.5]["gene"])
de_down_99 = set(res_99[res_99["log2FoldChange"] < -1.5]["gene"])

print("DE up intersection (all 3):", len(de_up_97 & de_up_98 & de_up_99))
print("DE down intersection (all 3):", len(de_down_97 & de_down_98 & de_down_99))

# Which pathways have these genes?
consist_up_genes = de_up_97 & de_up_98 & de_up_99
consist_down_genes = de_down_97 & de_down_98 & de_down_99

print(f"\nConsistent UP genes ({len(consist_up_genes)}): {consist_up_genes}")
print(f"Consistent DOWN genes ({len(consist_down_genes)}):")

# For each consistent down gene, show which pathways it belongs to
for gene in sorted(consist_down_genes):
    in_pathways = [pid for pid, genes in pathway_genes_raw.items() if gene in genes]
    if in_pathways:
        print(f"  {gene}: {in_pathways}")

# Now let me try ORA with |lfc|>1.5 but WITHOUT padj filter (which is the same as with since all pass)
# And let me look at nominal p-values, not adjusted
print("\n=== Checking nominally significant (p<0.05) pathways per strain ===")

    all_genes = set(res_df["gene"])

    de_down = set(res_df[res_df["log2FoldChange"] < -lfc_threshold]["gene"]) & universe

    for pid, pw_genes in pathway_genes.items():
        pw_in_u = pw_genes & universe
        if len(pw_in_u) < 2:
            continue

            c = len(pw_in_u) - a
            d = len(universe) - len(de_genes) - c
            
            table = [[a, b], [c, d]]
            _, pval = fisher_exact(table, alternative='greater')
            results[direction][pid] = pval
    
    return results

    all_genes = set(res_df["gene"])
    all_pw_genes = set()
    for genes in pathway_genes.values():
        all_pw_genes.update(genes)
    universe = all_genes & all_pw_genes
    N = len(universe)  # total balls
    
    de_up = set(res_df[res_df["log2FoldChange"] > lfc_threshold]["gene"]) & universe
    de_down = set(res_df[res_df["log2FoldChange"] < -lfc_threshold]["gene"]) & universe
    
    results = {}
    for direction, de_genes in [('up', de_up), ('down', de_down)]:
        K = len(de_genes)  # number of "success" balls
        
        for pid, pw_genes in pathway_genes.items():
            pw_in_u = pw_genes & universe
            n = len(pw_in_u)  # number of draws
            if n < 2:
                continue

            pval = hypergeom.sf(x - 1, N, K, n)

    all_kegg_genes.update(gs)
universe = all_genes & all_kegg_genes
N_universe = len(universe)

print(f"Universe size: {N_universe}")

# Define DE gene sets: |lfc| > 1.5
datasets = {}
for label, res_df in [('97', res_97), ('98', res_98), ('99', res_99)]:
    de_up = set(res_df[res_df["log2FoldChange"] > 1.5]["gene"]) & universe
    de_down = set(res_df[res_df["log2FoldChange"] < -1.5]["gene"]) & universe
    datasets[label] = {'up': de_up, 'down': de_down, 'n_up': len(de_up), 'n_down': len(de_down)}
    print(f"Strain {label}: DE up={len(de_up)}, DE down={len(de_down)}")

for label, ds in datasets.items():
    all_ora_results[label] = {}
    for direction, de_set in [('up', ds['up']), ('down', ds['down'])]:
        K = len(de_set)

            continue
        
        pathway_results = {}
        for pid, pw_genes in pathway_genes_raw.items():
            pw_in_u = pw_genes & universe
            n = len(pw_in_u)
            if n < 2:

            x = len(pw_in_u & de_set)
            if x == 0:

            # Hypergeometric test: P(X >= x)

                'fold_enrichment': fold_enrichment,
                'overlap': x,
                'pathway_size': n

            for pid, padj in zip(pids, padjs):
